text:
Debenhams' Hollywood Vanity Mirror can be wall mounted or set on the table (Image: Debenhams)

Ofgem have increased the energy price cap by 13% until the end of September, so shoppers are looking for ways to cut consumption. Advising consumers on a nifty trick to help save on bills, an energy expert told the Mirror in 2022 that 'swapping your fluorescent light bulbs with LEDs could save £232 each year as they use 80% less electricity'.

Practical as well as as pretty, the Natural Living and Home Large Hollywood Vanity Mirror boasts 15 LED light bulbs that last up to 50,0000 hours with three adjustable settings. Shoppers can help save energy by doing their makeup or skincare in front of this mirror.

One person stated: "Very practical. The lights are so good you don't need to put a lamp on within the room." At full price, Debenhams states the mirror is £99, but the retailer has currently reduced it to better than half price. A 53% discount brings the large mirror down to £47, plus, the code EXPRESSDEL gives free express delivery on this order.

READ MORE:

It can sit neatly on a tabletop, for example a dressing table, or can be wall mounted depending on the space. A happy customer wrote: "Lovely mirror. Very stable. Looks beautiful. It makes my dresser look amazing."

As well as dimmable settings, the colour of the lights can be changed from cold, to natural and warm. This is handy when doing makeup and wanting the right setting.

Switching to LED bulbs can help save energy costs.

Those that tend to forget to charge their phone before heading out for the day or night are in luck as the mirror also comes with a USB charging port. Consumers can keep their phone nearby when charging at the same time as doing their makeup.

At Debenhams, the Large Hollywood Vanity Mirror is a bestseller, rated 4.4 out of five by 71 people. Someone shared: "Very good quality for the price. I'm actually impressed with how expensive it looks and lights are very bright. Good for filming Tiktoks if anyone is interested in that. The size is perfect as the dimension of the thickness are not too bulky to have it on the stand."

Another person bought it as a gift, explaining: "Fabulously glamorous mirror that my granddaughter loves. Perfect size for vanity table, lights up really well and can be toned down if too bright."

The mirror has three adjustable light settings and a USB charging port(Image: Debenhams)

Leaving a mixed review, a customer deducted a star as the lead isn't as long as they would like. They wrote: "Lovely mirror, very glam! The lead is quite short so required some adaptations but very pleased with it overall. Good price and prompt delivery."

There are other options, should the Debenhams mirror not be suitable. At Wayfair, the Ivy Bronx Rectangle LED Metal Mirror is 52% off, now £81.99 down from £169.99. It also has three colour adjustable settings and a USB charging port.

Boasting 360 degree rotation, Amazon's Hollywood Vanity Mirror with LED Lights comes in at £37.98 in the sale. A smart memory function automatically recalls the last used setting, saving time and ensuring consistency for a daily routine.

Returning to the Debenhams mirror, a five star review reads: "Amazing glamorous mirror, great quality. Value for money. Great having USB port on the side to charge phone at the same time. The bulbs work really well."
